note: Small cottonwood-shaded park in Great Bend (2800 Main St) off US 281, near a gas station and a Dillons. Some pull-throughs are entered through the vet clinic's driveway to the north. Takes nightly, weekly, monthly and year-long stays. --Claude
summary: Confirmed (not waterfront); 17 full-hookup units (30/50 A) on Firefly, $38-40 a night, WiFi, no bathhouse or laundry; passes the private gates; long-stay occupancy flagged.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: rate $38 (Firefly quote dated 2026-11-10) / $40 posted, under $50. Presence: Google Sites page + Firefly booking + phone 620-792-4558 (Google Maps and Firefly). Ratings: Google 4.7 over 40, RV Life 4* over 10 ($$, avg_rate $27). Good Sam: not found in the directory (unknown; nothing written).

LONG-STAY (passes, but for AWH): the five tests pass on the published evidence: (1) $38-40 a night; (2) Firefly sells single nights online, no application or lease; (3) no minimum stated; (4) every unit is offered nightly; (5) not a home community. But 'year long stays are welcomed' at $525 a month, and on a November weeknight (2026-11-10) Firefly showed 11 of the 14 23-ft-capable units occupied, so much of the park is likely long-term. Not on the fence on price or reviews, so kept.
SITES: count 10 (derived from note prose) -> 17 Firefly units; 14 fit a 23-ft rig (15-A and 15-B are 21 and 20 ft).
FACILITIES: showers and laundry written false from 'No bath houses or laundry on-site'; flush toilets left unknown.
MILITARY: Firefly offers an 'Active or Retired Military' special rate; amount not shown.

PHONE 620-792-4558 confirmed (Google Maps, Firefly header 'Text 620-792-4558'). WEBSITE https://sites.google.com/view/cottonwoodgrovervpark/home confirmed; the page heading 'cottonwoodgrovervpark.com' does not resolve (DNS failure), so not proposed.
